term: Center for AI Standards and Innovation
def: The NIST center that leads US government testing of frontier AI for national-security risks and works with industry on voluntary standards; renamed from the US AI Safety Institute in 2025.
practice: Publishes capability assessments of US and foreign models, some jointly with the UK AI Security Institute; as of November 2026 NIST's page also calls it the Center for Advancing Innovation and Standards for Super Intelligence (CAISSI).
